messages:
alex.p: Quick question for the group — SI partner wants to list an integrated connector in the cloud marketplace. They asked what types of security/compliance artifacts we can share and what they can request access to. What’s our short checklist?

maria.s: We usually share: SOC2 Type II summary, pen-test summary (redacted vuln details), network diagrams (sanitized), and an artifact list with owners. Full reports need an NDA + presigned access. :ok_hand:

jamal.sec: Important: telemetry and logs = CUSTOMER DATA. We can't hand over raw logs or PCAPs without explicit customer consent. For SI onboarding, provide sanitized logs or synthetic samples only.

lucas.partners: fwiw the partner is asking for example auth flows and error telemetry to validate connector behavior — can we give them that without exposing PII?

jamal.sec: Yes — provide modeled traces and a small redacted sample. Add a header saying "sanitized sample". If they insist on real traces, route through a legal-approved presign process and limit TTL to 1 hour.

olivia.legal: +1. Any exchange of full reports (SOC/pen) requires an MSA addendum or explicit evidence sharing agreement. Use presigned S3 links with access logging and scope the S3 prefix. No screenshots of control evidence.

alex.p: Good call. For the marketplace listing itself, what do reviewers typically require vs. what we give to the SI integrator?

maria.s: Marketplace reviewers want attestation that controls exist and a statement of compliance (not raw evidence). SI integrator needs more operational artifacts to validate integration (deployment diagrams, token scopes, sample API responses).

jamal.sec: Practical checklist for integrator handoff:
- high-level SOC2 summary (public)
- redacted pen-test executive summary (public)
- sanitized network/deployment diagram (public)
- presigned artifacts (NDA) for detailed SOC2/pen (owners: security)
- short-lived API keys in staging for testing (approval required)

alex.p: Could you paste the presign workflow we prefer? I can forward to partner.

jamal.sec: sure — snippet:
```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-partner-evidence/si-bundle-2026.zip --expires-in 3600
# Link logged to evidence-sharing-audit log
```
Include usage notes: one-time download preferred, rotate after download.

lucas.partners: Partner asks about redaction standards — what fields must be removed from logs and diagrams?

jamal.sec: Remove: IPs tied to customers, user IDs, emails, API keys, and any hashed identifiers that are reversible. For diagrams, mask tenant IDs and any URLs that contain env or tenant info.

olivia.legal: Also append a signed attestation PDF that says the partner will not attempt re-identification and will delete artifacts after verification. We have a template.

alex.p: Timeline ask from partner — can we assemble a share pack by EOD Wednesday?

maria.s: Depends on security bandwidth. We can prepare public assets (SOC summary, redacted pen exec) by EOD. Presigned bundle will need jamal to review and olivia to countersign the sharing agreement — aiming Thu morning.

jamal.sec: I can carve out time Thu AM. Please create a JIRA with owner tags: security (jamal.sec), legal (olivia.legal), partnerships (alex.p) and attach the partner name + purpose.

alex.p: Will do. JIRA created: PART-8423. I'll post link in this thread shortly.

deploy-bot: Reminder: documentation deploy scheduled 2026-03-12 02:00 UTC; do not add live credentials to docs during that window.

lucas.partners: Thanks all — I'll tell the SI partner: public artifacts by EOD Wed, deeper bundle Thurs after NDA. Appreciate the clarity. :pray:
